question: In Gastric/GEJ trials where a non–PD-L1 biomarker was required, extract the biomarker name(s) from the trial name.
hidden_column: Is any other biomarker used for inclusion
pred_sql:
SELECT
  "Trial name"
FROM clinical_trials
WHERE
  "Cancer type" = 'Gastric/GEJ' AND "Is PD-L1 positivity inclusion criteria" = 'No';
